title: Capability Control Plane — semantic routing of unseen wording
verdict_reason: Held-out accuracy is 15.0% strict / 17.5% acceptable with the LLM selector enabled, against a justified bar of 75%. The binding constraint is model capacity, not prompt design: the only locally installed model is qwen2.5:0.5b (397,821,319 parameters), which reaches 34.4% on the same corpus, while the 120B cloud model reaches 78.7%. The cloud model returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) throughout this session, so the capable path could not be exercised.

field_semantics.note: An earlier evidence file was misread because these two fields were conflated. They are now defined explicitly and used consistently.
field_semantics.gate: REACH — whether the request passed the looks_actionable cost gate and was therefore submitted to the LLM at all. PASS here does NOT mean the answer was correct.
field_semantics.correct: CORRECT — whether the returned capability id matched the expected id. This is the only field that measures routing quality.
field_semantics.lesson: 'gate: PASS, correct: false' is a coherent state meaning 'the LLM was consulted and got it wrong'. It is not a contradiction, but the filename 'phase3_e2e_nemotron_verified.json' invited the opposite reading, so this file records the distinction explicitly.

pass_bar.justification: The deterministic layer already handles every phrasing it was written for, so the LLM selector is only useful on wording no pattern anticipated. A bar below roughly 60% would be indistinguishable from the keyword layer's own coverage and would not justify keeping an LLM in the interactive path. 75% is set above the 78.7% the 120B model actually achieved on a prior 61-item corpus, leaving no margin for a 0.5B model, and is stated in advance so the result cannot be rationalised after the fact.

measurement_configs.deterministic_only: WorkflowDecisionEngine with ai_engine=None and a live CapabilityResolver. Proves any gain is not merely 'something was turned on'.
measurement_configs.llm_local: Provider list pinned to Ollama (qwen2.5:0.5b) so the measurement cannot silently drift to another backend.
measurement_configs.llm_cloud: Provider list pinned to Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b). Returned HTTP 429 throughout this session.

model_capacity_evidence.note: The decisive comparison. Same corpus, same selector, different model.
model_capacity_evidence.conclusion: A 397M-parameter model cannot do semantic capability selection at a production bar. The prompt and routing work in this phase is necessary but not sufficient; the capable path exists and previously measured 78.7%, but it was unreachable this session because Groq returned HTTP 429.

code_delivered: capability_resolver.resolve_operation() returns a typed UNSUPPORTED result for unknown/empty/None operations instead of raising ValueError('capability_id cannot be empty.'). Both call sites (workflow_decision.py:3042, genesis.py:1237) were unguarded, so any unregistered intent aborted the request.

WorkflowDecisionEngine() now defaults to a real CapabilityResolver. Previously capability_resolver defaulted to None, which is precisely why 'resolver on' and 'resolver off' produced identical results.

Full resolution metadata is propagated through one shared helper (capability_resolution_metadata): status, capability_id, capability, confidence, dangerous, requires_confirmation, risk_level, provider, category, operation, explanation, evidence, alternatives. The two call sites previously hand-rolled a 4-field subset and could drift.

Provider-health ranking reads a live shared CapabilityProviderRegistry (get_shared/reset_shared, injectable) instead of constructing a throwaway registry whose health is all-None, which made health scoring silently inert. Unobserved health is now reported as neutral evidence rather than silently scoring nothing.

LLM selector: enriched category-grouped catalog carrying risk, inputs and SELECTION_BOUNDARIES notes; exact-id rule with explicit non-existent-id examples; _extract_json_preferring_valid_operation() which prefers a JSON object naming a real capability over one naming an invented id, while preserving an explicit null answer.

One-shot semantic repair: when the model names an id that does not exist, the id is fed back with genuinely similar real ids (token overlap + difflib) for a single correction, instead of discarding a correct understanding over a spelling slip.

Bounded provider concurrency: the per-call timeout is now genuinely enforced and abandoned workers are capped (_MAX_INFLIGHT_CALLS), and resolution is bounded end-to-end (_RESOLVE_TOTAL_BUDGET). Both naive variants were measured and both were wrong — joining defeats the timeout (51.9s against an 8s budget), unbounded abandonment collapses accuracy (7/10 -> 2/10).

pre_existing_issue_not_caused_by_this_ph.symptom: Fails only when test_level3_8_6_capability_resolution.py runs earlier in the same process.
pre_existing_issue_not_caused_by_this_ph.cause: CapabilityRegistry methods are classmethods, so register_default_capabilities(registry) called on an INSTANCE mutates class-level state, rewriting application.close's operation from 'application.close' to 'close'.
pre_existing_issue_not_caused_by_this_ph.proof: Reproduced with no code under test involved: calling register_default_capabilities(CapabilityRegistry()) flips the descriptor.
pre_existing_issue_not_caused_by_this_ph.status: left unmodified — it is a test-isolation defect outside Phase 3 scope, and the full-suite collection order happens to hide it.

what_would_close_phase_3: Install a model with real semantic capability (>=7B) and re-run phase3_benchmark.py heldout llm_local. This is the single highest-value unblock and requires no further code work.
Obtain non-rate-limited cloud access so the 120B path that previously measured 78.7% can be exercised against the current enriched catalog.

Reconcile deterministic/lexical precedence with the LLM. Observed live: 'turn the sound down a bit' is detected deterministically as volume.set while the LLM correctly says volume.down, and the deterministic answer wins. Until precedence is explicit, a better model cannot help.

Fix the conversational guard at workflow_decision.py:1609, which rejects question-format capability requests such as 'what is playing right now' and 'how do these two sheets stack up' before the semantic path is ever reached.

Reconsider the held-out generator: it wraps registry descriptions verbatim, producing items like 'execute the gui.double_click capability through the authoritative control plane'. No real user phrases a request that way, so this set is a harder and somewhat artificial target. It is reported as generated rather than tuned, but it should not be treated as a proxy for user-facing accuracy.
